children: The European Union has asked China to voluntarily restrict exports of hybrid cars as part of a deal to prevent a trade war, the Financial Times reported on Thursday.
Brussels wants Beijing to restrict sales of Chinese hybrid vehicles to around 15% of the EU market, the newspaper added, citing people familiar with the matter.
